trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow the roadmap: finish the story, protect the one missable trophy, then work the activities, collectibles and the 100% checklist. PowerPyx puts the whole run at about 200 hours at difficulty 4 out of 10.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: The opening mission. Play through the start of the story until the Gone Fishing mission completes — it unlocks automatically and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Story trophies unlock automatically as you play; none of them can be missed. Do the meditations offered in this chapter — one of them counts toward the missable Positive Mental Attitude.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Story trophies unlock automatically as you play; none of them can be missed.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. Story trophies unlock automatically as you play; none of them can be missed.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. Story trophies unlock automatically as you play; none of them can be missed. The bank vaults open up with an optional Chapter 4 mission — that is when Maximum Withdrawal becomes possible.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It unlocks automatically and is one of the two gold trophies. Keep a manual save at the start of the final mission — there is no mission replay, so a save lets you revisit the ending.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run story mission. It unlocks automatically as part of the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist story mission. It unlocks automatically as part of the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play story mission. It unlocks automatically as part of the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners story mission. It unlocks automatically as part of the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown story mission. It unlocks automatically as part of the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the Operation Savage Glory story mission. It unlocks automatically as part of the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy. After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and work the checklist. PowerPyx notes the thresholds are lenient — roughly 60% of true completion — and progress you made before the story ends already counts. Most of it comes from doing the other trophies: activities, collectibles and challenges.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land any 250 stunts: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in the world, so you have room to pick the easy ones; 100% completion needs 300. Stunts also count toward the activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt (PowerPyx's list). You only need to try each one, not win or finish it.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Get a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit every range and gold each challenge; the PSN count tracks 42. Take your time and learn each range's pattern.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Learn one track at a time; you only need one win per location.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race counts once, so work through the list rather than repeating one. Races also count as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and beat him. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so it also counts toward Master of None.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Play an arcade game through to its end. Any arcade game counts, and it is one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger mission strand — the final mission in his chain. Stranger strands are side content you can do after the story; they also count toward the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand — the final mission in his chain. Stranger strands are side content you can do after the story; they also count toward the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger mission strand — the final mission in his chain. Stranger strands are side content you can do after the story; they also count toward the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands. Only some side questlines count, and PowerPyx is still confirming which ones — do every stranger strand you find and the trophy will come. The five named stranger finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are a good start.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger mission strand — the final mission in his chain. Stranger strands are side content you can do after the story; they also count toward the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand — the final mission in his chain. Stranger strands are side content you can do after the story; they also count toward the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE missable one. Meditate at all 18 spots in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia. PowerPyx and GTABase flag this as the only possibly missable trophy: the first spot is offered at home in Chapter 1 — Lucia's balcony meditation — and becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter, and there is no mission replay. Do every meditation the moment it is offered, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret asks you to hunt a unique animal. Which animal and where it appears has not been pinned down by a guide yet — this entry marks it unconfirmed rather than guessing. Check PowerPyx or GTABase for the latest, and keep a save before you hunt.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Finish 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; collect them as you explore and the sets complete. Card hunting pairs well with exploring for The Goodtime State.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. Work it into your exploring — every new spot you tag counts, and it pairs with discovering vehicles and regions.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 challenges. Challenges overlap with the other trophies, so this one fills in as you play; check the challenge list to see what is left, and it counts toward the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Use a fast car, break line of sight, and stay out of the search area until it cools.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level — keep the heat on between robberies and move fast from one shop to the next.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Drive everything you see; each new vehicle you get in counts. Work it into your exploring — it pairs with WAiNK It and region discovery.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies before it ends. Pick a crowded fight, line the shots up, and do not let the focus run out early.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA airport by an unscheduled departure rather than the normal exit — the official description is the source here, and no guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet. Try leaving the airport grounds by an unconventional route.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The name and description point to the Rhino tank — get into a Rhino and stir up heat. The official description is the source here; no guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — plan the approach, stay out of sight, take what you need and get out clean before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults open up with an optional Chapter 4 mission and always bring 4 stars, so have a fast bike ready (GTABase).
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Hit it, grab the cash, and lose the heat before it builds.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 regions of Leonida. The PSN count tracks 52 — visit every corner of the map and the trophy pops. It pairs with WAiNK It, vehicle discovery and card hunting.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. Work through the gangs one at a time; each operation you hit counts toward the nine.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known — no guide has pinned down the exact spot or trigger. This entry marks it unconfirmed rather than guessing.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known — which showroom and what counts as 'classic style' has not been confirmed. Marked unconfirmed; check PowerPyx for the latest rather than smashing every showroom in the state.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Head to the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and follow through — bowl a game there. The description names the place; the exact trigger (a strike, a finished game) has not been confirmed by a guide yet.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The description is vague — a partnership with mass appeal — and no guide has confirmed what triggers it. Marked unconfirmed rather than guessing at a method.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: The description reads 'Choices made (for better or worse)' and the PSN count tracks 500 — but what counts as a choice has not been confirmed by any guide. Marked unconfirmed; the count may be dialogue choices or decisions across the game.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: The description gives no usable trigger — 'Second time's the charm' — and no guide has confirmed what to retry. Marked unconfirmed rather than guessing.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: The description gives no usable trigger — 'What the hell just happened?' — and PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known. Marked unconfirmed rather than guessing.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description points to bowling something over with a melee drive-by, but PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known — what to bowl over and where has not been confirmed. Marked unconfirmed rather than guessing.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Earn marked bills from robberies and run them through your contacts until the count is met.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. It adds up naturally if you buy weapons, clothes and cars as you play; if you are short at the end, buy and sell until the count is met.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Save up and purchase each one; the count on PSNProfiles tracks 8.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you like, register each one in the app, and the count climbs to 10.
trophies.name: On the Spot
